name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
summary: At Revantusk Village, Primal Torntusk asks you to save her mate after a bold midnight raid. Her spies say Elder Torntusk is alive atop Jintha'alor.

sections.title: A Midnight Raid
sections.body: Vilebranch savages struck Revantusk Village at midnight and seized Elder Torntusk, Primal Torntusk's mate. Her spies say he is alive, held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital in the southern Hinterlands. Primal Torntusk fears the village could not bear to lose him.

sections.title: The Faceless Blood God
sections.body: Vile Priestess Hexx is said to be preparing Elder Torntusk for sacrifice to Hakkar, the faceless blood God.

sections.title: Once You Reach Him
sections.body: Elder Torntusk is within reach, but the guards surely know you have arrived. Move quickly.

faq.answer: Vilebranch savages took Elder Torntusk in a bold midnight raid on Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Where is Elder Torntusk being held?
faq.answer: Primal Torntusk's spies say Elder Torntusk is a prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital in the southern Hinterlands.

faq.q: What fate awaits Elder Torntusk atop Jintha'alor?
aliases: what do vilebranch want with torntusk
faq.answer: Sacrifice. Word is that Vile Priestess Hexx is readying Elder Torntusk as an offering to Hakkar, the faceless blood God.
Primal Torntusk is Elder Torntusk's mate, and she asks you to save him.
